Quality Sushi, Big Tatami Room
Aug 2025 • Friends
The sushi here is a level a I’ve that in other Sai Gon locations. The unagi roll was big & excellent, & the half avocado topped with salmon poke was delicious & beautifully plated. 
I expect to pay somewhat more here, for the quality. But one big sashimi dish is very much overpriced. The Yen Deluxe Sashimi should have had a lot more variety & pieces. For 788,000 VNĐ (about $30 US), there should have been more. There were 3 pieces each of only 5 types, plus toe (eggs). Yen should compare this with other upscale sushi eateries. 
Service was good. The tatami room was lovely & big-there are quite a few of them.
